definitions.explanation: A musical instrument played by pressing keys on a keyboard, such as the piano, organ, harpsichord, or synthesizer.

examples.japanese: ピアノは{鍵盤楽器|けんばんがっき}の{代表|だいひょう}だ。
examples.english: The piano is the quintessential keyboard instrument.

examples.japanese: {鍵盤楽器|けんばんがっき}を{習|なら}いたい。
examples.english: I want to learn a keyboard instrument.

examples.japanese: オルガンやチェンバロも{鍵盤楽器|けんばんがっき}に{分類|ぶんるい}される。
examples.english: Organs and harpsichords are also classified as keyboard instruments.

notes:
{鍵盤楽器|けんばんがっき} is a compound of {鍵盤|けんばん} (keyboard) and {楽器|がっき} (musical instrument). The three main categories of Western instruments in Japanese are {弦楽器|げんがっき} (string instruments), {管楽器|かんがっき} (wind instruments), and {打楽器|だがっき} (percussion instruments). {鍵盤楽器|けんばんがっき} is sometimes treated as a subcategory of percussion or as its own group.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鍵盤楽器|けんばんがっき}を{弾|ひ}く — to play a keyboard instrument
- {鍵盤楽器|けんばんがっき}{奏者|そうしゃ} — keyboard player

RELATED WORDS:
- {鍵盤|けんばん} — keyboard (of an instrument)
- {楽器|がっき} — musical instrument
- {弦楽器|げんがっき} — string instrument
- {管楽器|かんがっき} — wind instrument
